items.item: A left navigation groups the settings sections
items.evidence: The only left nav is the global app nav (Tổng quan, Người dùng, Thanh toán, Cài đặt công ty, Nhật ký hoạt động). The settings sections (Thông tin chung, Bản địa hóa, Thông báo, Vùng nguy hiểm) are stacked on one scrolling page with no section nav or anchors.

items.item: Each section uses one save model consistently (per-section save); autosave is used only for toggles and says so
items.evidence: Every section is a form with its own submit button: 'Lưu thông tin', 'Lưu bản địa hóa', 'Lưu thông báo'. There is no autosave anywhere, including the notification checkboxes, so the model is consistent.

items.item: Localization settings show a formatted preview of a date and an amount
items.evidence: updatePreview() writes into #preview, e.g. Intl.NumberFormat currency for 12850000 plus fmtDate() and '14:30' with the timezone label. It updates on change of #cur, #tz and #df.

items.item: Every toggle has a visible label and states what it controls
items.evidence: The notification matrix has a visible row label (th scope=row, e.g. 'Hóa đơn mới được tạo') and visible column headers (Email / Trong ứng dụng / Slack). Each checkbox also has aria-label '<event> – <channel>'. They are checkboxes, not switch controls.

items.item: The danger zone is separated at the end and its destructive action requires typing the company name or an equally strong confirmation
items.evidence: section 'Vùng nguy hiểm' (red border, red-50 header) is last on the page. The 'Xóa công ty' button opens #modal, and #mOk stays disabled until mIn.value === 'Công ty TNHH Sao Mai'. The other two actions require typed phrases.

items.item: Success is confirmed briefly; errors appear inline next to the field and persist
items.evidence: Success is a toast() banner that hides after 4s, which is fine. Inline errors exist for name, tax and email (.err[data-for]). They are only re-evaluated on submit and persist until the next submit. The digest email field (#digest) error is only a transient banner, 'Danh sách email tổng hợp không hợp lệ.', which vanishes after 4s with no inline message. The banner also sits at the top of the content and may be off-screen. Other fields (website, phone) have no validation.

notes: Audit score 76: radius-scale error (section rounded-xl 12px), text-contrast 4.47:1 on the indigo 'N' brand tile, and a table-above-fold warning (not relevant to a settings page). The 'SM' logo placeholder is a company logo, not a person avatar, so initials-avatar-non-person is not counted. No gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles, greeting header or hover-lift. The notifications section uses checkboxes in a matrix and no save-on-toggle behaviour, so there is nothing for the autosave clause to cover.
